name: open-erd
description: Generate interactive single-file SVG ERDs, Excel sheets and readable diffs from any project's source code.

interface.shortDescription: Draw an interactive ERD of a project's database from its source code.
interface.longDescription: Adds six skills: create an ERD workspace from source code, keep it in sync, review the relations the AI found, compare two versions, answer questions from the model, and send feedback. Needs Node 20.10 or later; the engine is bundled.
defaultPrompt: Draw an ERD of this project with open-erd.
Update the open-erd ERD after the latest code changes.
What changed in the database since the v1.0 tag?
